correctness.rationale: Summing the shift autocorrelations gives T²=(3+S)/3. Odd extension degree excludes a quadratic subfield and hence forces T rational; a reduced denominator s would satisfy s²|3, so T is integral. S=3(T²−1) is odd with |S|≤17; T must be even, leaving 0 or ±2 and respectively seven or thirteen positive signs. The symmetric circulant Gram spectrum has constant mode T² and paired modes k,35−k with 3λ_k=3+∑σ_a cos(2πka/35). For nonzero k, the full root sum gives the equivalent 3λ_k=7/2+2∑_(a∈P) cos(2πka/35), also for nonunits. Independently replayed all combinations with python3 /workspace/replay/shift35_review.py, using alternating arctangent brackets for π, a rational Taylor bound plus cosine's Lipschitz bound, and outward rounding at scale 10^18. The 19,448 and 2,380 candidates gave 19 and zero survivors with no ambiguous signs. The 19 have λ₀=0 and all other λ_k≥67924701873905317/1500000000000000000, exceeding the frozen common bound. Independent orbit grouping verified disjoint sizes 12,3,4 and the three frozen representatives. Real shift-only realizability follows by Fourier inversion of the symmetric coefficients sqrt(λ_k), with the forward transform unnormalized and inverse divided by 35; this gives the autocorrelation and squared norm one. It does not realize a prescribed field degree or impose any nonzero modulation equation. The bundled rational code at verification/spectral_census.py was inspected, not executed; its positive-definite print label means strict positivity on the nonconstant subspace for survivors, not on the whole space.
